title: Review, keep and cancel a fleet order
description: Four independent commanders enter through actual authenticated controls. The owner reviews and keeps an accepted formation, preserves a separate unsubmitted draft, then cancels with one authoritative receipt. Released forces never execute at the cancelled boundary. Owner and independent-player views show private reservations and recovery. Explicit domain clocks are harness controls; this does not certify cutoff-edge timing, managed keys or hosted cadence.
